name: The Clawlight Keeper
description: The lighthouse didn't sink—it grew claws. Now its unlikely keeper prowls the drowned coast, guiding lost souls through the fog and snapping at whatever follows. Now with animated beacon light, floating keeper lights and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking navy-cloaked coastal keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.
